External Job Description

 Job Summary :
 Build a Bigger, Better, Bolder Future: 
Imagine working for a company that measures its success based off the growth of its colleagues, a company that invests in its future by investing in you. Little Caesars is a company where our colleagues make an impact.

 You Mission: 









 The Oracle BI Publisher and APEX Developer will design, build, and support technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Supply Chain and Manufacturing systems. This role focuses on APEX development, Oracle Integration Cloud, and supporting critical shop floor and warehouse operations.  
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Design and develop solutions for Oracle Fusion SCM (Manufacturing, Inventory, Supply Chain) 
 Build and enhance APEX applications, Fusion extensions, and integrations 
 Develop integrations using REST services and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) 
 Collaborate with business and functional teams to define requirements 
 Troubleshoot and support Fusion SCM and APEX applications 
 Support testing, deployments, and quarterly Fusion updates 
 Optimize performance of applications and integrations 
 Maintain documentation and follow development standards 
 Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues during evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed 
 Provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams on requirements, solution options, and production support considerations 
 Support release activities, including regression testing, deployment coordination, and post-release validation 
 
 Role Expectations and Core Competencies: 
 Role operates in a fast-paced environment and requires managing multiple priorities. 
 Requires cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication 
 Involves problem-solving for both technical and business issues 
 Role requires attention to detail, quality execution and collaboration with cross-functional teams 
 Role involves working with complex data and delivering results within defined timelines 
 Understanding of supply chain processes (O2C, P2P, Inventory, Fulfillment) 
 Experience with reporting tools: BI Publisher (BIP), OTBI, dashboards  
 Testing knowledge: SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management 
 
 Who You Are: 
 Bachelor’s Computer Science, Engineering, Information System, Technology or related field or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 3years of ERP / enterprise application development experience 
 3years of Oracle Fusion and cloud integration experience 
 Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion SCM modules 
 Hands-on experience in custom report writing 
 Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) 
 Expertise in Oracle APEX, SQL, and PL/SQL and custom report Development  
 Experience in Visio, Microsoft applications (Excel for reconciliation and data validation, PowerPoint) 
 
 Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 
 Certification on Oracle Cloud Platform Application Integration  
 Experience with Fusion quarterly updates 
 Exposure to Oracle Fusion environments 
 
 Disclaimer: 
 The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job.  It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.
 
 #LI-JS1
 
 
 All items listed above are illustrative and not comprehensive.  They are not contractual in nature and are subject to change at the discretion of Little Caesars Enterprises Inc.       
 
 Little Caesar Enterprises, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to that individual’s race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.                                   
The Company will strive to provide reasonable accommodations to permit qualified applicants who have a need for an accommodation to participate in the hiring process (e.g., accommodations for a job interview) if so requested.
